auth: Local ES256 test signer with real Convex JWT verification; production identity/membership policies

results.name: Signed ES256 JWT is verified and bound to workspace membership
Anonymous callers cannot invoke admin-only fixtures or business commands
Forged signatures, expired JWTs, wrong issuer and wrong audience are denied
Owner command creates the real meeting/agenda/minutes/attachment graph atomically
Lost acknowledgement replay has one durable effect and stable ID mappings
Viewer retains allowed reads but cannot upload commands
Foreign workspace reads, uploads and role changes are denied
Stale revisions cannot overwrite accepted preparation
Native file upload verifies content hash before linking metadata
Two independently authenticated WebSocket clients observe committed child edits
Last active Owner cannot be demoted, removed or ordinarily disabled
Viewer cannot grant themselves Owner authority
Promoting another Owner allows demotion; current roles gate even receipt replays
Disabled membership denies reads and disappears after explicit projection rebuild

limitations: No live Clerk or tenant-restricted Microsoft login flow exercised
PowerSync service/download replication not exercised by this test
ACL/membership projection invalidation still requires explicit rebuild
Local cloud-workspace instance, not the user's Mac or Zoer host
Production unscoped files:generateUploadUrl and callers require workspace-context integration; the pilot uses a scoped endpoint
productionSourceChange: shared/portable/define.ts: use server environment without falling through to import.meta
